Module com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship
Package com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.Player

Class PlayerBot

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.Player.APlayer
com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.Player.PlayerBot
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPlayer, Serializable
public class PlayerBot extends APlayer
Represents the bot player in the Battleship game.

The PlayerBot class extends APlayer and implements the bot's logic for generating its ships, attacking positions, and managing its state.

The bot uses randomized strategies for ship placement and attacks while adhering to the game's rules. It also maintains information about its own and the enemy's ships.

This class is serializable to allow saving and loading of game states.

Author:
Juan David Lopez V

  • Method Details

    • generateBotGame

      public void generateBotGame()
      Description copied from interface: IPlayer
      Generates the bot's ship placements randomly on the game board.

      This method initializes a predefined number of ships of different sizes, assigns them random positions and orientations, and ensures that no ships overlap.

      It updates the bot's ship matrix with the placed ships and handles potential exceptions caused by invalid placements.

      Specified by:

      Overrides:
